# Count films per year
films_per_year = df.groupby('Year').size()

# Find the maximum count
max_films = films_per_year.max()

# Get the year(s) with that maximum count
years_with_max = films_per_year[films_per_year == max_films].index.tolist()

# Prepare the answer
answer = {
    'max_films': int(max_films),
    'years': years_with_max
}
